title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
description: Discover the specific study nooks, student-run hubs, and quiet outdoor retreats that define the daily student experience at Allegheny College.

cards.title: Student-Run Coffeehouse Hub
cards.subtitle: Henderson Campus Center, Second Floor
cards.notes: Visit this volunteer-run spot for fair-trade coffee and milkshakes. It serves as a central social hub for studying and community events in an alcohol-free environment.
cards.short_summary: A student-managed, non-profit coffeehouse focused on sustainability and community gathering.
cards.evidence_claim: Grounds for Change is a volunteer and student-run coffeehouse located on the second floor of the Henderson Campus Center.
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; typical hours are 8 AM to midnight on weekdays with weekend variations.

cards.title: Upper Floor Writing Retreat
cards.subtitle: Pelletier Library, Third Floor
cards.notes: Head to the third floor for this dedicated community writing and meeting space. It offers a focused environment away from the busier main floor traffic.
cards.short_summary: A specialized classroom and meeting space on the library's upper floor used for collaborative writing.
cards.evidence_claim: The Collaboratory is located on the upper floor of Pelletier Library and serves as a classroom and meeting space.
cards.source_title: Pelletier Library Floor Maps and Directions - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library operating hours; some sessions may be reserved for specific groups.

cards.title: Sustainable Teaching Garden
cards.subtitle: Adjacent to Carr Hall
cards.notes: Explore this 3,000-square-foot garden where students grow organic produce. It features an experimental greenhouse that generates its own solar power.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on learning garden and solar-powered greenhouse producing food for campus dining.
cards.evidence_claim: Carr Hall Garden is a nearly 3,000 square foot teaching garden with an experimental, power-generating greenhouse.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor garden area is generally viewable; greenhouse access is typically for classes and volunteers.

cards.title: Vukovich Center Green Roof
cards.subtitle: Vukovich Center for Communication Arts
cards.notes: Walk along cedar walkways through lavender and native trees on this rooftop garden. It functions as a sustainable stormwater management system and quiet retreat.
cards.short_summary: A landscaped green roof terrace featuring native plants and scenic campus views.
cards.evidence_claim: Laura's Rooftop Terrace is a green roof garden with cedar walkways and native plants atop the Vukovich Center.
cards.access_notes: Open to the campus community during building hours; accessible via the Vukovich Center.

cards.title: Historic Student Gathering Space
cards.subtitle: Brooks Hall
cards.notes: Utilize this recently renovated lounge for studying and social justice dialogue. It honors the first Black graduate of Allegheny College.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated space for inclusion and social justice engagement located within Brooks Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The William C. Jason Diversity Lounge in Brooks Hall was renovated and renamed in February 2023.
cards.source_title: Diversity lounge renamed, renovated - The Campus
cards.access_notes: Located in Brooks Hall; accessible to students for study and organized IDEAS Center programming.

cards.title: Sunset View Dance Space
cards.subtitle: Montgomery Performance Space
cards.notes: Visit the upper studio in 'Monty' for a peaceful atmosphere and expansive sunset views through large windows. It is a favorite for yoga and movement.
cards.short_summary: An elevated dance and movement studio known for its tranquil environment and scenic views.
cards.evidence_claim: The upper studio in Montgomery Performance Space is noted by students for its sunset views and peaceful atmosphere.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; primarily used for dance and movement studies classes.

cards.title: Third Floor Natural Light Nook
cards.subtitle: Henderson Campus Center, Third Floor
cards.notes: Find this quiet lounge on the top floor of the Campus Center. It offers natural light from above, making it an ideal spot for focused reading.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, naturally lit study lounge located on the third floor of the student union.
cards.evidence_claim: The Skylight Lounge is listed as a facility on the third floor of the Henderson Campus Center.
cards.source_title: Campus Center and Store - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open during Henderson Campus Center hours (typically 6 AM to midnight or 1 AM).

cards.title: Central Outdoor Activity Hub
cards.subtitle: Center of Campus
cards.notes: Gather on this central green space for orientation activities, club fairs, and casual outdoor studying. It serves as the primary outdoor crossroads for students.
cards.short_summary: The main campus quadrangle used for major student events and daily recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gator Quad is a central campus location used for orientation activities and student organization events.
cards.source_title: Gator Weekend of Welcome - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public campus outdoor space.

cards.title: Historic Outdoor Event Space
cards.subtitle: Near Bentley Hall
cards.notes: Visit this plaza featuring salvaged brick and historic lighting. While used for commencement, it offers a stately setting for outdoor group meetings.
cards.short_summary: A formal outdoor plaza integrated into the historic campus core for ceremonies and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Bicentennial Plaza is an outdoor event plaza located near the historic buildings of the campus core.
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 as a public campus outdoor space.

cards.title: Main Floor Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Pelletier Library, Main Floor
cards.notes: Access peer tutoring and academic coaching in this central library hub. It provides a collaborative environment with easy access to research librarians.
cards.short_summary: A holistic student support center offering tutoring and advising in a central library location.
cards.evidence_claim: The Maytum Center for Academic Success is located on the main floor of Pelletier Library.
cards.source_title: Maytum Center for Academic Success - Allegheny College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library hours; professional staff available during standard business hours.
